items.title: 10+ Years Factory Expertise

items.title: 100% Eco-Friendly Materials
items.desc: FSC-certified papers, soy-based inks, and biodegradable coatings. Every material we use is chosen to protect both your brand reputation and our planet's future.

items.desc: Start with just 100 pieces. Samples ready in 3–5 business days, bulk production in 10–15 days. We move at the speed your business demands.

about.title: A Factory Built on Craft & Conscience
about.p1: Founded over a decade ago, EcoPack Studio has grown from a small workshop into a full-scale packaging manufacturer serving clients across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.
about.p2: We believe packaging is the first physical touchpoint between a brand and its customer. That's why every box we produce is designed to create a moment of delight — sustainably.
about.p3: Our 8,000 sqm facility houses state-of-the-art printing, die-cutting, and finishing equipment, operated by a team of 120+ skilled craftspeople committed to quality in every detail.

contact.title: Let's Create Something Beautiful Together
